name: report_token_accounting
requirement: W1-01 (W1 builder extract); REQ-27 (a); addendum section 5 item 1; REV3 section 9.3 item 1 (report only)
rule: per arm: the rows removed, rewritten and added; their target tokens (response + end-of-turn) and total row tokens (prompt + target); each as a share of P's corpus totals, never the edited corpus's; per unit and per category; the edited corpus's rows, tokens and optimizer steps = ceil(rows / rows_per_step); an add or rewrite edit takes its new rows' counts from its writer's text-free record, cross-checked; a scored-only set is reported as the rows it would remove
